content.value: Two $C 3 1 0 \times 4 5$ channels are latticed together so they have equal moments of inertia about the principal axes. Determine the minimum length of a column having this section, assuming pinned ends, $E = 2 0 0 ~ \mathrm { G P a } ,$ and a proportional limit of 240 MPa. What safe load will the column carry for a length of 12 m with a factor of safety of2.5?
